intuition: A shortest transformation uses one-letter changes, so breadth-first search explores words in increasing path length.

brute_force.approach: Compare every discovered word against every dictionary word to find one-letter neighbors.

optimal.approach: Build wildcard-pattern buckets and use BFS to visit each transformation level.

edge_cases: If the end word is absent from the dictionary, no sequence can reach it.
The sequence length includes both the begin and end words.
